verdict.rationale: The only official client library in the evidence is EBANX.js, a first-party JavaScript library used for card tokenization and device fingerprinting, plus a pre-built embeddable UI component. Integration is otherwise documented as direct calls to a single unified REST API. Agent Skills and the integration prompt are guidance for AI assistants, not SDKs. Missing for 10: server-side SDKs in mainstream languages (e.g. Node, Python, Java, PHP), SDK reference docs or package listings, a published OpenAPI spec for generating clients (the probe returned 404 on all candidate paths), and independent corroboration of SDK quality.
